newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down on lack of support.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down on lack of support.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Thursday as prices of blue chips tumbled on lack of support from local and foreign investors. Dealers said the index would ease further in the near term.
The Karachi 100-share index fell 18.31 points, or 1.24 percent, to end at 1,456.99. Losers beat gainers 160 to 88.
"The market is faced with a liquidity crunch," one dealer said. "The slide in Indian stocks also has a negative impact."
Hub Power fell 0.45 rupees to 34.05 and ICI Pakistan 0.50 to 22.15. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
